newsitem.title: USA: Stocks fall as early rally gives way to profit-taking.
newsitem.headline: Stocks fall as early rally gives way to profit-taking.

text.p: Stocks tumbled for the second straight session Wednesday as investors continued to take profits in large, blue-chip issues.

The Dow Jones industrial average fell 50.68 points to 6,392.01 in afternoon trading after losing 79 points on Tuesday, much of that in the last minutes of trading. In the broader market, declining issues led advances by a 13-10 margin on the New York Stock Exchange.
